text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide wins the spring<n>Tenno Sho. But
even so, the racing<n>world still sees her as no more
than<n>Narita Brian's sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If the venue for the race hadn't been<n>changed,
Biwa Hayahide could've<n>maximized the results of
her equation<n>and put on an even better
performance...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But she reminds me that there's no<n>use dwelling
on something we had no<n>control over and urges me
to focus on<n>the future instead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the exclusive<n>Takarazuka Kinen,
where only the<n>best are chosen to race. We begin
working hard so Biwa Hayahide can<n>show the
racing world just how<n>strong she is.
